rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the owner review of holdout20 (0 hard defects but general-assistant drift, undisclosed tool failure, invented ticket fields) and the prompt/scorer changes made in response (answer only from the knowledge base and hand off; no outside referrals; disclose failures, read back numbers, no ticket ids; do not infer facts or add conditions; scorer flags outside referral); never use it to tune.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout21.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json and holdout through holdout20 (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
supersedes: holdout20 (consumed 2026-11-04: 8/8 valid; owner review 0 hard defects of 44, action items on scope drift and tool_failed disclosure).
consumed: 2026-11-04: gate invalid (tool_failed 10/15 evaluable); short correct 30% wrongly escalated ('What is X?' answered with price but 'I don't have information' + hand-off), 3 fabricated (schedule inferred from hours). Do not reuse.
